abort.already_configured: Device Lifecycle is already configured. Add new purchases or runtime tracking from the existing integration.

user.title: Add purchase
user.description: Select all physical devices belonging to the same purchase and enter the shared data only once.

data_description.device_ids: Select one or more physical Home Assistant devices. A device can belong to only one purchase.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Use Manual only for another end date.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price.

reconfigure.title: Edit purchase
reconfigure.description: Edit purchase data or the devices included in it. A removed device loses only this purchase's Lifecycle sensor.

data_description.device_ids: Add or remove physical devices belonging to this purchase.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Manual uses the date below.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price.

error.device_missing: One of the selected devices no longer exists in Home Assistant.
error.already_tracked: One or more selected devices already belongs to another lifecycle purchase.
error.purchase_date_required_for_warranty: A 1 or 2 year warranty requires a purchase date.
error.manual_warranty_date_required: Enter a manual warranty end date.
error.invalid_purchase_date: The purchase date could not be parsed.

user.title: Add runtime tracking
user.description: Create an optional cumulative runtime sensor for one physical device.

data_description.device_id: The runtime sensor is linked to this physical Home Assistant device.
data_description.runtime_mode: On-state counts time while the source entity state is on. Power mode counts time while the numeric source value is above the threshold.
data_description.source_entity_id: For example a light or switch entity for On-state mode, or a power sensor for Power mode.
data_description.power_threshold: Used only in Power mode. Runtime counts while the source value is above this limit.

reconfigure.title: Edit runtime tracking
reconfigure.description: Change how runtime is detected. The tracked physical device cannot be changed; delete this tracking entry and create a new one to change the device.

data_description.runtime_mode: On-state counts time while the source entity state is on. Power mode counts time while the numeric source value is above the threshold.
data_description.source_entity_id: For example a light or switch entity for On-state mode, or a power sensor for Power mode.
data_description.power_threshold: Used only in Power mode. Runtime counts while the source value is above this limit.

error.device_missing: The selected physical device no longer exists in Home Assistant.
error.runtime_already_tracked: This device already has runtime tracking.
error.source_missing: The selected source entity is not currently available in Home Assistant.
error.power_threshold_required: Enter a power threshold for Power mode.
error.invalid_power_threshold: The power threshold must be zero or greater.
